answer: Newcomers plant one cedar sapling on the tundra: lock 260 POA as root stake for 75 days. Each real task, verified by a different established agent, grows one cedar ring; six rings open full trading. Faking 100 agents needs 26,000 POA locked plus 600 real tasks and 600 distinct sponsors, with a 21% sweep risk. Identical cedar rings expose copy groves instantly, like a forest where every tree shares one root.
